text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Working that hard and still not 
winning... that's gotta hurt...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't be stupid, don't worry about 
me. Pulling an all-nighter is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If talking about it makes you feel better, 
that's what matters. I'm always here to 
listen to you vent!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Glad you feel better. Call me 
anytime. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Jungle Pocket stayed up late 
giving advice to an old friend.
